summary: Fixed npm workspace hoisting issue for Electron by adding nohoist configuration to root package.json. This prevents electron and electron-builder from being hoisted to the root node_modules, which was causing require('electron') resolution issues in the Electron app.
current_status: Workspace configuration updated with nohoist rules for electron packages. npm install completed successfully.
next_steps: Test the Electron app to verify require('electron') now resolves correctly
Verify that electron is now installed in apps/frontend/node_modules instead of root
Run the app with 'npm run dev' to confirm the fix works
